intro.headline:
A local identity,
held only by you.
intro.description: Parties identifies you with a cryptographic key generated and stored on this device. There is no account, no email, and no server-side recovery. Whoever holds the key is the identity.
intro.footer: Keys never leave this machine unless you export them.

intro.headline:
This phrase is
your only backup.
intro.description: These twelve words regenerate your private key. Anyone with them controls your identity, and no one — including this client — can recover them for you. Write them down and store them offline.
intro.footer: Never paste your phrase into a website or chat.

identity_seed.title: Back up your recovery phrase

intro.headline:
Restore an
existing identity.
intro.description: Enter the twelve-word recovery phrase you saved when the identity was first generated. The same key will be reconstructed locally.
intro.footer: Words are validated against the standard word list.
